verdict.rationale: Shopify's own help docs include a section titled "Using Shopify POS offline", so some first-party offline mode exists. Nothing in the pack says card payments specifically can be taken offline, or that transactions are stored and forwarded once connectivity returns. The Tap to Pay page only describes taking payments over WiFi and cellular, which does not show offline operation. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that card payments are accepted offline, documentation of the store-and-forward behavior and its limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
